papers.title: Transanal tube for the prevention of anastomotic leakage in rectal cancer surgery
papers.journal_full: The Cochrane database of systematic reviews
papers.authors: Kawamura H, Tsujimoto Y, Miyakawa T, Hashimoto K, Hirano T, Honda M
papers.abstract:
RATIONALE: Anastomotic leakage is a serious complication of rectal cancer surgery, causing morbidity and increasing healthcare burden. A diverting stoma reduces anastomotic pressure but carries risks. A transanal tube near the anastomosis may reduce spasms and drain stool, potentially lowering leakage risk.
OBJECTIVES: To evaluate the benefits and harms of a transanal tube for the prevention of anastomotic leakage in people undergoing rectal surgery, compared with no transanal tube.
SEARCH METHODS: We searched Cochrane Central Register of Controlled Trials (CENTRAL), MEDLINE via Ovid, Embase via ProQuest, and four clinical trial registries. The latest search was conducted on 6 August 2025.
ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA: We included all randomised controlled trials (RCTs) that compared the use of a transanal tube with no intervention in adults undergoing rectal cancer surgery.
OUTCOMES: The critical outcomes were anastomotic leakage, surgical re-intervention due to anastomotic leakage, and any postoperative adverse events other than anastomotic leakage within 30 days postoperatively. Important outcomes included the overall incidence of anastomotic leakage, postoperative length of hospital stay, accidental early removal of the transanal tube, and tube-related complaints.
RISK OF BIAS: We used the Cochrane RoB 2 tool to assess risk of bias in the included RCTs.
SYNTHESIS METHODS: We used random-effects meta-analyses to calculate risk ratios (RR) and mean differences (MD) with 95% confidence intervals (CI). If meta-analysis was not feasible, we summarised the findings narratively. Heterogeneity was assessed using the I² statistic, and substantial heterogeneity (I² > 50%) was explored via prespecified subgroup analysis. The certainty of evidence was evaluated with GRADE. Due to substantial heterogeneity in anastomotic leakage data, possibly influenced by diverting stoma status, we performed prespecified subgroup analyses according to diverting stoma status.
INCLUDED STUDIES: Four RCTs were included, involving 1318 participants: 666 in the transanal tube group and 652 in the no-intervention group.
SYNTHESIS OF RESULTS: All included studies were judged to have an overall risk of bias of "some concerns". Overall, the certainty of evidence ranged from very low to low because of the risk of bias, inconsistency, and imprecision. The evidence is very uncertain about the effect of a transanal tube on the risk of anastomotic leakage (RR 0.88, 95% CI 0.46 to 1.72; 4 RCTs, 1318 participants; very low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk of anastomotic leakage was 83 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 73 per 1000 (95% CI 38 to 142) in the transanal tube group (NNT = 100). A test for subgroup differences suggested that the effect of a transanal tube differed according to diverting stoma status (P = 0.03). Among people without a diverting stoma, the RR for anastomotic leakage was 0.72 (95% CI 0.36 to 1.43; 3 RCTs, 911 participants). The anticipated absolute risk was 89 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 64 per 1000 (95% CI 32 to 127) in the transanal tube group. Among people with a diverting stoma, the RR was 2.38 (95% CI 1.00 to 5.69; 2 RCTs, 250 participants). The anticipated absolute risk was 52 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 124 per 1000 (95% CI 52 to 297) in the transanal tube group. A transanal tube may reduce the risk of surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage (RR 0.32, 95% CI 0.10 to 1.00; 3 RCTs, 1124 participants; low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk of surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage was 45 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 14 per 1000 (95% CI 4 to 45) in the transanal tube group (NNT = 33). Among people without a diverting stoma, the RR for surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage was 0.25 (95% CI 0.07 to 0.94; 2 RCTs, 806 participants). The evidence is very uncertain about the effect of a transanal tube on the risk of postoperative adverse events other than anastomotic leakage (RR 1.19, 95% CI 0.76 to 1.88; 2 RCTs, 555 participants; very low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk was 174 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 207 per 1000 (95% CI 132 to 327) in the transanal tube group (NNH = 30). Among people without a diverting stoma, the RR for postoperative adverse events other than anastomotic leakage was 1.39 (95% CI 0.94 to 2.04; 1 RCT, 398 participants). The evidence is very uncertain about the effect of a transanal tube on the risk of overall anastomotic leakage (RR 0.87, 95% CI 0.46 to 1.66; 4 RCTs, 1318 participants; very low-certainty evidence). The anticipated absolute risk of overall anastomotic leakage was 87 per 1000 in the no-intervention group and 76 per 1000 (95% CI 40 to 145) in the transanal tube group (NNT = 91). One RCT involving 398 participants, all without a diverting stoma, found that a transanal tube may reduce postoperative length of hospital stay (MD -3.25 days, 95% CI -4.55 to -1.95; low-certainty evidence). Accidental early transanal tube removal occurred in 2.7% (range 0-8.2%) of participants with a transanal tube. Tube-related complaints were reported in 25.2% of participants (range 1.9-46.4%).
AUTHORS' CONCLUSIONS: A transanal tube may reduce the risk of surgical re-intervention for anastomotic leakage. However, its effect on anastomotic leakage remains uncertain. Subgroup analyses suggested that the effect may differ according to diverting stoma status, with more anastomotic leakage observed with a transanal tube among people with a diverting stoma. Future trials should report outcomes separately according to diverting stoma status and standardise transanal tube characteristics.
FUNDING: This Cochrane Review did not receive direct funding from any organisation.
REGISTRATION: The protocol is available at doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD015472.

papers.title_zh: 經肛管引流用於預防直腸癌手術後吻合口滲漏
papers.abstract_zh:
研究背景：吻合口滲漏是直腸癌手術的嚴重併發症，會造成病態且增加醫療負擔。分流性造口可降低吻合口壓力但伴隨風險。放置於吻合口附近的經肛管可能減少痙攣並引流糞便，有可能降低滲漏風險。
目的：評估經肛管用於預防接受直腸手術者吻合口滲漏之利弊，與不使用經肛管比較。
搜尋方法：我們搜尋了 Cochrane CENTRAL、經 Ovid 之 MEDLINE、經 ProQuest 之 Embase，以及四個臨床試驗註冊平台。最後搜尋日期為2025年8月6日。
納入條件：納入所有比較經肛管使用與不介入、於成人直腸癌手術中的隨機對照試驗（RCT）。
結果指標：關鍵結果為吻合口滲漏、因吻合口滲漏而需手術再介入，以及術後30天內任何非吻合口滲漏之不良事件。重要結果包括吻合口滲漏總發生率、術後住院天數、經肛管意外提早移除，以及與管路相關之不適主訴。
偏誤風險：我們使用 Cochrane RoB 2 工具評估納入RCT的偏誤風險。
統合方法：使用隨機效應統合分析計算風險比（RR）與平均差（MD）及其95%信賴區間。若無法進行統合分析則以敘述方式呈現。使用I²統計量評估異質性，顯著異質性（I²>50%）則透過預先設定的次群組分析探討。使用GRADE評估證據確定性。由於吻合口滲漏數據存在顯著異質性，可能受分流性造口狀態影響，我們依分流性造口狀態進行預先設定的次群組分析。
納入研究：共納入4項RCT，包含1318名參與者：經肛管組666人，未介入組652人。
結果統合：所有納入研究整體偏誤風險皆判定為「有些疑慮」。整體而言，因偏誤風險、不一致性與不精確性，證據確定性從極低到低不等。經肛管對吻合口滲漏風險的效果證據非常不確定（RR 0.88，95% CI 0.46至1.72；4項RCT，1318名參與者；極低確定性證據）。未介入組吻合口滲漏預期絕對風險為每千人83例，經肛管組為每千人73例（95% CI 38至142）（NNT=100）。次群組差異檢定顯示經肛管效果依分流性造口狀態而不同（P=0.03）。在無分流性造口者中，吻合口滲漏RR為0.72（95% CI 0.36至1.43；3項RCT，911名參與者）。預期絕對風險未介入組為每千人89例，經肛管組為每千人64例（95% CI 32至127）。在有分流性造口者中，RR為2.38（95% CI 1.00至5.69；2項RCT，250名參與者）。預期絕對風險未介入組為每千人52例，經肛管組為每千人124例（95% CI 52至297）。經肛管可能降低因吻合口滲漏需手術再介入的風險（RR 0.32，95% CI 0.10至1.00；3項RCT，1124名參與者；低確定性證據）。未介入組手術再介入預期絕對風險為每千人45例，經肛管組為每千人14例（95% CI 4至45）（NNT=33）。在無分流性造口者中，手術再介入RR為0.25（95% CI 0.07至0.94；2項RCT，806名參與者）。經肛管對於非吻合口滲漏之術後不良事件風險的效果證據非常不確定（RR 1.19，95% CI 0.76至1.88；2項RCT，555名參與者；極低確定性證據）。預期絕對風險未介入組為每千人174例，經肛管組為每千人207例（95% CI 132至327）（NNH=30）。在無分流性造口者中，非吻合口滲漏術後不良事件RR為1.39（95% CI 0.94至2.04；1項RCT，398名參與者）。經肛管對整體吻合口滲漏風險的效果證據非常不確定（RR 0.87，95% CI 0.46至1.66；4項RCT，1318名參與者；極低確定性證據）。未介入組整體吻合口滲漏預期絕對風險為每千人87例，經肛管組為每千人76例（95% CI 40至145）（NNT=91）。一項納入398名參與者（皆無分流性造口）的RCT發現，經肛管可能縮短術後住院天數（MD -3.25天，95% CI -4.55至-1.95；低確定性證據）。經肛管意外提早移除發生率為2.7%（範圍0-8.2%）。管路相關不適主訴發生率為25.2%（範圍1.9-46.4%）。
作者結論：經肛管可能降低因吻合口滲漏需手術再介入的風險。然而其對吻合口滲漏本身的效果仍不確定。次群組分析顯示效果可能依分流性造口狀態而異，在有分流性造口者中使用經肛管反而觀察到更多吻合口滲漏。未來試驗應依分流性造口狀態分別報告結果，並統一經肛管的規格特性。
經費來源：本Cochrane回顧未接受任何機構直接資助。
註冊：計畫書可於 doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD015472 取得。

papers.title: Effectiveness and Safety of Colorectal Cancer Screening Via Fecal Occult Blood Testing: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Frankenfeld M, Patah G, Soares L, Silva S, Romeiro F, Nogueira V
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: This systematic review evaluated the effectiveness of population-based colorectal cancer (CRC) screening programs using fecal occult blood tests (gFOBT or FIT) among adults aged 45-75 years.
METHODS: We included studies comparing participants in population-based CRC screening programs with unscreened individuals. Outcomes were all-cause mortality, CRC-specific mortality, CRC incidence, and stage IV CRC incidence. Two reviewers independently performed study selection, data extraction, and risk-of-bias assessment. Pooled RRs were calculated by meta-analysis, and certainty of evidence was assessed using GRADE.
RESULTS: No difference was observed in all-cause mortality (RR = 1.00, 95% CI 0.99-1.01; 5 studies, 1,474,576 participants; moderate-certainty evidence). RCTs evaluating gFOBT demonstrated a reduction in CRC-specific mortality (RR = 0.89, 95% CI 0.84-0.94; 5 studies, 1,474,576 participants; moderate-certainty evidence), corresponding to 38 fewer CRC deaths per 100,000 individuals screened (95% CI, 55 fewer to 21 fewer). Non-RCTs evaluating FIT reported larger reductions in CRC-specific mortality (RR = 0.21, 95% CI 0.20-0.21; 5 studies, 7,435,956 participants), although the certainty of evidence was low. RCTs showed no significant effect on CRC incidence or stage IV CRC incidence, whereas non-RCTs evaluating FIT suggested reductions in both outcomes; however, the certainty of evidence was also low.
CONCLUSION: Fecal occult blood test-based screening reduces CRC-specific mortality but not all-cause mortality. FIT-based screening may provide additional benefits by reducing CRC incidence and stage IV disease; however, these findings are supported by low-certainty evidence and require confirmation in RCTs.

papers.title_zh: 糞便潛血檢測用於大腸直腸癌篩檢之有效性與安全性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 目的：本系統性回顧評估以糞便潛血檢測（gFOBT或FIT）為基礎之族群性大腸直腸癌（CRC）篩檢計畫，在45-75歲成人中的有效性。方法：納入比較族群性CRC篩檢計畫參與者與未篩檢者之研究。結果指標包括全因死亡率、CRC特異性死亡率、CRC發生率及第四期CRC發生率。兩位審閱者獨立進行研究篩選、資料萃取與偏誤風險評估。以統合分析計算彙整RR，並以GRADE評估證據確定性。結果：全因死亡率無差異（RR = 1.00，95% CI 0.99-1.01；5篇研究，1,474,576名參與者；中等確定性證據）。評估gFOBT之RCT顯示CRC特異性死亡率降低（RR = 0.89，95% CI 0.84-0.94；5篇研究，1,474,576名參與者；中等確定性證據），相當於每篩檢10萬人減少38例CRC死亡（95% CI，減少55例至減少21例）。評估FIT之非RCT研究則報告更大幅度的CRC特異性死亡率降低（RR = 0.21，95% CI 0.20-0.21；5篇研究，7,435,956名參與者），但證據確定性為低。RCT顯示對CRC發生率或第四期CRC發生率無顯著影響，而評估FIT之非RCT則顯示兩項結果皆有降低，惟證據確定性亦為低。結論：以糞便潛血檢測為基礎之篩檢可降低CRC特異性死亡率，但不影響全因死亡率。以FIT為基礎之篩檢可能提供額外益處，降低CRC發生率與第四期疾病，惟此發現僅由低確定性證據支持，仍需RCT證實。
papers.score_reason: 彙整大型RCT與非RCT資料，方法嚴謹並用GRADE分級，但FIT相關的最大益處僅來自低確定性非RCT證據，實務參考價值中等。
papers.relevance_why: 篩檢政策影響病人就診時的疾病分期與轉介外科的時機，但本身非外科介入措施。
papers.one_liner: 彙整gFOBT RCT與FIT非RCT研究（合計逾百萬至千萬人），糞便潛血篩檢降低CRC特異性死亡率但不影響全因死亡率（RR 0.89 vs 1.00）。
papers.action: 目前不需改變做法：持續支持既有FIT篩檢政策，並向病人說明篩檢可降CRC死亡但非全因死亡，FIT對發生率之益處仍待RCT證實。

pico.P: 45-75歲成人，接受族群性CRC篩檢計畫者（多篇研究合計最多7,435,956人）
pico.O: 主要：全因死亡率、CRC特異性死亡率；次要：CRC發生率、第四期CRC發生率

key_numbers: 全因死亡率無差異：RR 1.00（95% CI 0.99-1.01），5篇研究147萬人
gFOBT RCT降低CRC死亡：RR 0.89（0.84-0.94），每10萬人少38例死亡
FIT非RCT降低CRC死亡更大：RR 0.21（0.20-0.21），但證據確定性低
cautions: gFOBT RCT（RR 0.89）與FIT非RCT（RR 0.21）效應量差距懸殊，非RCT恐有健康篩檢者偏誤等混淆因子
FIT對發生率與第四期疾病之益處僅由低確定性非RCT證據支持，尚未經RCT證實
僅報RR與信賴區間，未提供各組事件數/總人數等原始絕對數字，無法自行核算ARR
unassessable: 納入研究間異質性程度
篩檢間隔與參與率細節

papers.context: 本篇統合分析涵蓋先前看過的FIT篩檢死亡率降低結果（西班牙、瑞典世代研究），並進一步以GRADE系統性比較gFOBT RCT與FIT非RCT證據，補上『全因死亡率無差異』此一先前未特別強調之陰性結果，並指出FIT效應量遠大於gFOBT恐反映非RCT設計偏誤。

papers.title: Toxicities of Fruquintinib in Gastrointestinal Malignancies: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
papers.authors: Jones D, Sangha T, Manjikian A, Ghobrial M, Shawesh Q, Tiwana E
papers.abstract: Backgrounds: Fruquintinib is a selective vascular endothelial growth factor receptor (VEGFR)-1/2/3 inhibitor approved for previously treated metastatic colorectal cancer. As its use expands across gastrointestinal (GI) malignancies and combination regimens, randomized evidence is needed to define the toxicity profile most relevant to clinical monitoring, particularly hypertension, dermatologic toxicity, renal toxicity, bleeding, and thrombotic events. The objective of this study was to synthesize randomized controlled trial evidence to quantify the incidence and relative risk of key toxicities associated with fruquintinib in gastrointestinal malignancies. Methods: MEDLINE, EMBASE, and Cochrane CENTRAL were searched from inception through 1 January 2026 for phase II-III randomized controlled trials of fruquintinib in GI cancers reporting hypertension, proteinuria, hemorrhage, venous thromboembolism (VTE), and hand-foot skin reaction or palmar-plantar erythrodysesthesia (HFSR/PPE). Trial-reported CTCAE adverse events were pooled as risk ratios (RRs) with 95% confidence intervals (CIs) using Mantel-Haenszel random-effects models. Exploratory subgroup analyses were performed in metastatic colorectal cancer (mCRC). Results: Four randomized trials (n = 1872) were included. Fruquintinib significantly increased grade ≥3 hypertension (RR 9.01, 95% CI 4.67-17.40) and grade ≥3 HFSR/PPE (RR 26.00, 95% CI 6.42-105.29). Any-grade proteinuria was also increased (RR 1.89, 95% CI 1.30-2.74). Grade ≥3 hemorrhage occurred at low absolute rates and was numerically higher with fruquintinib, but the pooled estimate did not reach statistical significance (RR 1.82, 95% CI 0.92-3.61). VTE estimates were imprecise because of sparse events (any-grade VTE: RR 1.23, 95% CI 0.53-2.88; grade ≥3 VTE: RR 1.96, 95% CI 0.52-7.36). Conclusions: In randomized evidence across GI malignancies, the principal safety signals associated with fruquintinib are grade ≥3 hypertension and grade ≥3 HFSR/PPE, together with increased any-grade proteinuria. Grade ≥3 hemorrhage was uncommon and numerically higher, whereas VTE estimates remained imprecise. These findings support early blood pressure optimization, proactive dermatologic management, routine urinalysis monitoring, and individualized assessment of bleeding and thrombotic risk when initiating therapy.

papers.title_zh: Fruquintinib於胃腸道惡性腫瘤之毒性：系統性回顧與統合分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：Fruquintinib是一種選擇性血管內皮生長因子受體(VEGFR)-1/2/3抑制劑，已核准用於先前治療過之轉移性大腸直腸癌。隨著其應用擴展至各種胃腸道(GI)惡性腫瘤及聯合治療方案，需要隨機對照試驗證據來界定與臨床監測最相關的毒性profile，尤其是高血壓、皮膚毒性、腎臟毒性、出血與血栓事件。本研究目的為綜合隨機對照試驗證據，量化fruquintinib於胃腸道惡性腫瘤中相關關鍵毒性之發生率與相對風險。方法：檢索MEDLINE、EMBASE及Cochrane CENTRAL資料庫，自建庫起至2026年1月1日，納入報告高血壓、蛋白尿、出血、靜脈血栓栓塞(VTE)及手足皮膚反應/掌蹠紅斑感覺不良症候群(HFSR/PPE)之fruquintinib於GI癌症二/三期隨機對照試驗。試驗報告之CTCAE不良事件以Mantel-Haenszel隨機效應模型合併為風險比(RR)及95%信賴區間(CI)。並於轉移性大腸直腸癌(mCRC)進行探索性次群組分析。結果：共納入4項隨機試驗(n=1872)。Fruquintinib顯著增加3級以上高血壓(RR 9.01，95% CI 4.67-17.40)及3級以上HFSR/PPE(RR 26.00，95% CI 6.42-105.29)。任何等級蛋白尿亦增加(RR 1.89，95% CI 1.30-2.74)。3級以上出血絕對發生率低，fruquintinib組數值上較高，但合併估計未達統計顯著性(RR 1.82，95% CI 0.92-3.61)。VTE估計因事件稀少而不精確(任何等級VTE：RR 1.23，95% CI 0.53-2.88；3級以上VTE：RR 1.96，95% CI 0.52-7.36)。結論：在跨GI惡性腫瘤之隨機證據中，與fruquintinib相關之主要安全性訊號為3級以上高血壓及3級以上HFSR/PPE，並伴隨任何等級蛋白尿增加。3級以上出血並不常見但數值上較高，而VTE估計仍不精確。這些發現支持在起始治療時早期優化血壓、主動皮膚科管理、常規尿液分析監測，以及對出血與血栓風險進行個別化評估。

papers.title: Upadacitinib treatment in pediatric Crohn's disease: 52-week outcomes of an international multicenter retrospective cohort study from the pediatric IBD Porto Group of ESPGHAN
papers.authors: Spencer E, Cohen S, Dubinsky M, Suskind D, Mitrova K, Hradsky O
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND AIMS: Data on upadacitinib maintenance therapy in pediatric Crohn's disease (CD) are scarce. We aimed to evaluate the effectiveness, safety, and dosing of upadacitinib as maintenance therapy in pediatric CD.
METHODS: Children treated with upadacitinib for maintenance of remission of active CD from 35 centers affiliated with the Porto Group of ESPGHAN were included in this retrospective cohort study. Data on demographic, clinical, laboratory, endoscopic, and imaging findings and on adverse events (AEs) were recorded over 52 weeks of follow-up.
RESULTS: A total of 120 children were included (91 receiving upadacitinib as monotherapy and 29 as combination advanced therapy, mean age 15.4 ± 2.5 years). Prior to upadacitinib induction, 119/120 (99%) children had been treated with biologic therapies, 104 (87%) with two or more biologics and 98 (82%) had failed both vedolizumab and ustekinumab. Clinical remission and corticosteroid-free clinical remission (CFR) were observed after upadacitinib induction in 77 (64%) and 72 (60%) children, respectively. By week 52, 74 (62%) children achieved both clinical remission and CFR, and CFR was sustained in 66 (55%) children. CFR with normal C-reactive protein levels was achieved in 50% of children and CFR with fecal calprotectin levels <150 µg/g was achieved in 33% of children by week 52. Fifty-three (44%) children sustained AEs, two of which were serious (severe acne and intestinal perforation). The most frequent AEs were acne (n = 23), hyperlipidemia (n = 18), and infections (n = 14).
CONCLUSION: Upadacitinib is an effective maintenance therapy for refractory pediatric CD. Effectiveness should be weighed against the potential risks of AEs.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景與目的：兒童Crohn氏症（CD）使用upadacitinib維持治療的資料稀少。本研究目的為評估upadacitinib作為兒童CD維持治療的療效、安全性與劑量。方法：本回溯性世代研究納入來自ESPGHAN Porto Group 35個中心、以upadacitinib維持活動性CD緩解的兒童。追蹤52週，記錄人口學、臨床、實驗室、內視鏡與影像學發現，以及不良事件（AEs）。結果：共納入120名兒童（91名接受upadacitinib單一療法，29名接受合併進階治療，平均年齡15.4±2.5歲）。在使用upadacitinib誘導前，119/120（99%）曾接受生物製劑治療，104名（87%）曾使用兩種以上生物製劑，98名（82%）曾對vedolizumab與ustekinumab治療失敗。誘導後臨床緩解與無類固醇臨床緩解（CFR）分別達77名（64%）與72名（60%）。至第52週，74名（62%）兒童達到臨床緩解與CFR，66名（55%）持續維持CFR。至第52週，50%兒童達到CFR併C反應蛋白正常，33%兒童達到CFR併糞便鈣結合蛋白<150 µg/g。53名（44%）兒童發生不良事件，其中2例為嚴重不良事件（嚴重痤瘡與腸穿孔）。最常見的不良事件為痤瘡（n=23）、高血脂（n=18）與感染（n=14）。結論：Upadacitinib對難治性兒童CD是有效的維持治療，其療效需與潛在不良事件風險權衡考量。

papers.title: Effectiveness and safety of tacrolimus versus infliximab as rescue therapy for intravenous corticosteroid-refractory acute severe ulcerative colitis: a multicenter cohort study
papers.authors: Katano T, Okabayashi S, Yamazaki H, Matsubayashi M, Serizawa K, Nakashima M
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND & AIMS: Acute severe ulcerative colitis (ASUC) refractory to intravenous corticosteroids (IVCS) is a major clinical challenge with limited rescue therapy options. Although tacrolimus has been proposed as a potential rescue therapy, its effectiveness and safety compared with infliximab, widely used in this setting, remain unclear.
METHODS: A multicenter retrospective cohort study was conducted across 34 Japanese institutions, including hospitalized patients with IVCS-refractory ASUC who received infliximab or tacrolimus as rescue therapy between January 2014 and March 2023. The primary outcome was clinical remission at day 14, using two-item patient-reported outcome scoring. Secondary outcomes included clinical response at day 3 and 7, colectomy, and adverse events within 56 days. A modified Poisson regression model was used for analysis.
RESULTS: Among 300 patients (infliximab, n = 113; tacrolimus, n = 187), clinical remission at day 14 occurred in 41.6% and 33.7%, respectively, with no difference (adjusted risk ratio [RR] 0.87 [95% CI: 0.65, 1.17]). Clinical response at day 3 was lower with tacrolimus (infliximab 42.5% vs tacrolimus 24.1%; adjusted RR 0.58 [95% CI: 0.42, 0.80]) but did not differ at day 7 (infliximab 63.7% vs tacrolimus 51.9%; adjusted RR 0.83 [95% CI: 0.69, 1.01]). No difference in colectomy within 56 days was observed, although rates were higher in the tacrolimus (13.3% vs 20.3%; adjusted RR 1.58 [95% CI: 0.93, 2.67]). Adverse events were similar between groups (infliximab 8.8% vs tacrolimus 7.5%; adjusted RR 0.77 [95% CI: 0.37, 1.57]).
CONCLUSIONS: Tacrolimus demonstrated comparable effectiveness and safety to infliximab as rescue therapy for IVCS-refractory ASUC, although early response was slower.

papers.title_zh: Tacrolimus 與 Infliximab 作為靜脈類固醇難治型急性重度潰瘍性大腸炎（ASUC）之搶救治療：多中心世代研究比較其療效與安全性
papers.abstract_zh:
背景與目的：對靜脈類固醇（IVCS）治療無效的急性重度潰瘍性大腸炎（ASUC）是臨床一大挑戰，搶救治療選項有限。雖然tacrolimus已被提出作為潛在搶救治療，但其療效與安全性相較於廣泛使用的infliximab仍不明確。
方法：本研究為一項多中心回溯性世代研究，涵蓋日本34家機構，納入2014年1月至2023年3月間因IVCS難治型ASUC住院並接受infliximab或tacrolimus作為搶救治療之病人。主要結果為第14天臨床緩解，使用兩項病人自述結果評分。次要結果包括第3天與第7天臨床反應、大腸切除術、以及56天內不良事件。使用修正式Poisson迴歸模型進行分析。
結果：共300名病人納入分析（infliximab組n=113；tacrolimus組n=187）。第14天臨床緩解率分別為41.6%與33.7%，兩組無顯著差異（校正後風險比[RR] 0.87 [95% CI: 0.65, 1.17]）。第3天臨床反應率tacrolimus組較低（infliximab 42.5% vs tacrolimus 24.1%；校正後RR 0.58 [95% CI: 0.42, 0.80]），但第7天則無差異（infliximab 63.7% vs tacrolimus 51.9%；校正後RR 0.83 [95% CI: 0.69, 1.01]）。56天內大腸切除率兩組無顯著差異，雖然tacrolimus組數值較高（13.3% vs 20.3%；校正後RR 1.58 [95% CI: 0.93, 2.67]）。不良事件發生率兩組相似（infliximab 8.8% vs tacrolimus 7.5%；校正後RR 0.77 [95% CI: 0.37, 1.57]）。
結論：Tacrolimus在IVCS難治型ASUC搶救治療中展現與infliximab相當的療效與安全性，但早期反應較慢。

papers.title: Clinical characteristics and treatment patterns of elderly versus non-elderly adults with inflammatory bowel disease in Brazil: a cross-sectional study
papers.authors: Campos V, de Almeida Couto G, Surlo V, Lisboa R, Mota J, Pimentel A
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is increasingly diagnosed in older adults, but data from Latin America remain limited. This study aimed to compare the clinical, phenotypic and therapeutic characteristics of elderly and non-elderly adults with IBD in Brazil.
METHODS: This cross-sectional study included adults with confirmed Crohn's disease (CD) or ulcerative colitis (UC) attending an IBD clinic in Brazil. Patients were stratified as elderly (≥60 years) or non-elderly (<60 years); elderly individuals were further categorised according to age at diagnosis (<60 years vs ≥60 years). Clinical, therapeutic and frailty-related data were collected from medical records and structured interviews. The primary outcome was biologic therapy use.
RESULTS: 450 patients were included in the study (115 elderly, 335 non-elderly). UC was more common among the elderly patients (77.4% vs 56.7%, p<0.001). Elderly patients had higher comorbidity scores (2.6 vs 0.3 for CD; 2.6 vs 0.4 for UC; p<0.001) and greater polypharmacy (21.7% vs 3.3%, p<0.001) but similar disease activity (CD: Harvey-Bradshaw Index <5, 92.2% vs 79.3%; UC: Mayo Score <2, 88.6% vs 78.3%). They received fewer biologics (26.1% vs 43.6%, p=0.001) and immunosuppressants (22.6% vs 47.5%, p<0.001). Among elderly patients, immunosuppressant use was lower in those diagnosed at ≥60 years (2.9% vs 30.9%, p=0·001). Most elderly patients (82.3%) were robust according to the Clinical Frailty Scale.
CONCLUSION: Elderly patients were less likely to receive biologic and immunosuppressive therapy despite similar disease activity and had substantially greater comorbidity burden and polypharmacy. These findings suggest that therapeutic decisions in older adults should incorporate frailty and comorbidity assessment to support individualised age-adapted management.

papers.title: The DCBLD2 super-enhancer drives colorectal cancer progression through FOSL2/JUND-mediated activation of the CD146/AKT/TNFRSF6B pathway
papers.authors: Wu T, Shao L, Hu X, He H, Chen L, Feng M
papers.abstract: Super-enhancers are clusters of cis-regulatory elements that sustain the expression of cell-identity genes. Their aberrant activation or dysfunction constitutes a hallmark of malignant cellular transformation, which frequently rewires oncogenic transcriptional programs to support uncontrolled cell proliferation and metastatic potential. However, the functions and epigenetic regulation mechanisms of colorectal cancer specific super-enhancers remain poorly understood, and few studies have focused on dissecting how tumor enriched super-enhancers mediate downstream oncogenic signaling in CRC. By integrating multi-omics sequencing data, we identified a highly active super-enhancer in colorectal cancer, termed DCBLD2-SE. Through luciferase reporter assays, the SE3-2 subregion was identified as the minimal functional core of this super-enhancer. Mechanistic studies confirmed that transcription factors of the activator protein-1 family (FOSL2 and JUND) can bind directly to the SE3-2 cis-regulatory element, synergistically regulating local chromatin remodeling and strongly driving the upregulation of the target gene DCBLD2. Following knockout of the DCBLD2-SE core region, the malignant proliferative capacity of colorectal cancer cells decreased significantly, and the growth of xenograft tumors in vivo was markedly inhibited. Functionally, DCBLD2-SE facilitates tumor progression through a DCBLD2-dependent CD146/AKT/TNFRSF6B signaling axis. Clinically, high expression of DCBLD2 correlates with malignant metastasis and poor overall survival in patients with colorectal cancer. In summary, this study uncovers a previously undescribed DCBLD2-centered regulatory cascade that promotes colorectal cancer initiation and progression. DCBLD2-SE and its binding transcription factor activator protein-1 represent promising prognostic biomarkers and actionable therapeutic targets for colorectal cancer.

papers.title_zh: DCBLD2超增強子透過FOSL2/JUND活化CD146/AKT/TNFRSF6B路徑驅動大腸直腸癌進展
papers.abstract_zh: 超增強子是維持細胞身份基因表現的順式調控元件叢集。其異常活化或功能失調是惡性細胞轉化的標誌之一，經常重塑致癌轉錄程式以支持不受控的細胞增殖與轉移潛能。然而，大腸直腸癌特異性超增強子的功能與表觀遺傳調控機制仍所知有限，鮮少研究聚焦於解析腫瘤富集的超增強子如何介導下游致癌訊息傳遞。透過整合多體學定序數據，我們鑑定出一個在大腸直腸癌中高度活躍的超增強子，命名為DCBLD2-SE。透過螢光素酶報告基因分析，SE3-2次區域被鑑定為此超增強子的最小功能核心。機轉研究證實，活化蛋白-1家族的轉錄因子（FOSL2與JUND）可直接結合SE3-2順式調控元件，協同調控局部染色質重塑，並強力驅動標的基因DCBLD2的上調表現。剔除DCBLD2-SE核心區域後，大腸直腸癌細胞的惡性增殖能力顯著下降，體內異種移植腫瘤生長亦受到明顯抑制。功能上，DCBLD2-SE透過DCBLD2依賴性的CD146/AKT/TNFRSF6B訊息軸促進腫瘤進展。臨床上，DCBLD2高表現與大腸直腸癌病人的惡性轉移及較差整體存活相關。總結而言，本研究揭露了一個先前未被描述、以DCBLD2為中心的調控串聯，促進大腸直腸癌的起始與進展。DCBLD2-SE及其結合轉錄因子活化蛋白-1代表大腸直腸癌具潛力的預後生物標記與可作用治療標的。

papers.title: Macrophage pyroptosis in inflammatory bowel disease: mechanistic insights, pathological roles and treatment strategies
papers.authors: Yu Z, Zhao Z, Tian Y, Xue G, Wang J, Li Y
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is a chronic, relapsing inflammatory disorder of the intestinal tract. Imbalanced intestinal immune homeostasis, particularly macrophage pyroptosis, plays a central role in the pathogenesis of IBD. Pyroptosis is a pro-inflammatory form of programmed cell death mediated by the gasdermin protein family. It is characterized by cellular swelling, membrane rupture, and the massive release of inflammatory mediators. Under physiological conditions, moderate pyroptosis contributes to the maintenance of intestinal immune homeostasis by eliminating intracellular pathogens and releasing immunomodulatory signals. However, aberrant activation of pyroptosis triggers the excessive release of inflammatory mediators and damage signals that drive the initiation and progression of intestinal inflammation. Recent studies have shown that macrophage pyroptosis is profoundly involved in the pathological evolution of IBD. Upon stimulation by danger signals, macrophages undergo pyroptosis and release a high amount of inflammatory mediators that remodel the local immune network. Macrophage pyroptosis can also directly impair the intestinal mucosal barrier, thereby driving the pathological progression of IBD. This article systematically reviews the molecular mechanisms involved in pyroptosis, summarizes the pathological mechanisms through which macrophage pyroptosis drives IBD progression, and introduces various therapeutic strategies targeting macrophage pyroptosis to alleviate IBD. Finally, this review provides novel perspectives for the mechanistic research and precision treatment of IBD and facilitates the clinical translation of strategies targeting macrophage pyroptosis.

papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）是一種慢性、反覆發作的腸道發炎性疾病。腸道免疫homeostasis失衡，特別是巨噬細胞焦亡（pyroptosis），在IBD致病機轉中扮演核心角色。焦亡是一種由gasdermin蛋白家族所媒介的促發炎程式性細胞死亡，其特徵為細胞腫脹、細胞膜破裂，以及大量發炎介質釋放。在生理狀態下，適度的焦亡透過清除細胞內病原體及釋放免疫調節訊號，有助於維持腸道免疫homeostasis。然而，焦亡異常活化會觸發過量發炎介質與損傷訊號釋放，驅動腸道發炎的起始與進展。近期研究顯示，巨噬細胞焦亡深度參與IBD的病理演變。在危險訊號刺激下，巨噬細胞發生焦亡並釋放大量發炎介質，重塑局部免疫網絡。巨噬細胞焦亡亦可直接損害腸道黏膜屏障，進而驅動IBD病理進展。本文系統性回顧焦亡相關分子機轉，總結巨噬細胞焦亡驅動IBD進展的病理機轉，並介紹針對巨噬細胞焦亡以緩解IBD的各種治療策略。最後，本綜述為IBD機轉研究與精準治療提供新觀點，並促進針對巨噬細胞焦亡策略的臨床轉譯。

papers.title: Interplay between pathogen-mediated immune evasion and innate immune negative regulation in gastrointestinal tumors
papers.authors: Shi M, Zeng Y, Chen C, Zuo X
papers.abstract: Persistent colonization by gastrointestinal pathogens is an important environmental factor contributing to the development and progression of gastric and colorectal cancer. Helicobacter pylori (H. pylori), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), Fusobacterium nucleatum (F. nucleatum), enterotoxigenic Bacteroides fragilis (ETBF), and pks-positive Escherichia coli (E. coli) can induce chronic inflammation and reshape the tumor microenvironment via virulence factors, epithelial barrier disruption, DNA damage, and immune dysregulation. Conventional views have largely focused on the tumor-promoting effects of chronic inflammation; however, this view does not fully explain the coexsistence of persistent inflammation and immune evasion during chronic infection. In this review, we proposed that the key feature of pathogen-associated inflammation is not simply its intensity but rather the imbalance between sustained inflammatory stimulation and insufficient immune elimination. Rather than treating pathogen-mediated immune evasion, host-derived innate immune negative regulation, and adaptive immune checkpoint suppression as parallel mechanisms, this review examined how these functionally distinct layers converge in gastrointestinal tumors. Pathogen immune evasion allows persistent microbial stimulation, host negative-feedback pathways dampen PRR- and interferon (IFN)-associated signaling, and checkpoint-mediated suppression further impairs cytotoxic clearance. Together, these processes create a state in which sustained inflammation coexists with insufficient immune elimination. This state can impair antigen presentation, cytotoxic immune responses, and pathogen clearance, thereby promoting immune tolerance and tumor progression. Understanding this mechanism may offer a conceptual basis for pathogen control, innate immune reprogramming, and precision therapeutic intervention in gastrointestinal tumors.

papers.abstract_zh: 腸胃道病原體的持續定殖是胃癌與大腸直腸癌發生與進展的重要環境因子。幽門螺旋桿菌（H. pylori）、EB病毒（EBV）、具核梭桿菌（F. nucleatum）、產腸毒素脆弱擬桿菌（ETBF）、以及pks陽性大腸桿菌（E. coli）可透過毒力因子、上皮屏障破壞、DNA損傷與免疫失調誘發慢性發炎並重塑腫瘤微環境。傳統觀點主要聚焦於慢性發炎的促腫瘤效應，然而此觀點無法完全解釋慢性感染期間持續發炎與免疫逃逸並存的現象。本綜述提出，病原體相關發炎的關鍵特徵並非單純其強度，而是持續發炎刺激與免疫清除不足之間的失衡。本文不將病原體介導的免疫逃逸、宿主先天免疫負向調節、以及後天免疫檢查點抑制視為平行機制，而是檢視這些功能上不同的層面如何在腸胃道腫瘤中匯聚。病原體免疫逃逸使微生物持續刺激得以存在，宿主負反饋路徑抑制PRR與干擾素（IFN）相關訊號，而檢查點介導的抑制進一步損害細胞毒性清除能力。這些過程共同造成持續發炎與免疫清除不足並存的狀態。此狀態可損害抗原呈現、細胞毒性免疫反應與病原體清除，進而促進免疫耐受與腫瘤進展。理解此機制可為腸胃道腫瘤的病原體控制、先天免疫重編程與精準治療干預提供概念基礎。

papers.title: Extracellular vesicle-based therapies in IBD: immunomodulation, regeneration, and translation
papers.authors: Lu E, Sun M, Meng H, Zhang M
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) is sustained by dysregulated mucosal immune activation, maladaptive immune-cell crosstalk, epithelial barrier failure, and impaired tissue repair. This narrative review critically evaluates unmodified native mammalian EVs, donor-conditioned EVs, milk-derived EVs, post-isolation engineered EV products, and plant-derived EV-like nanoparticles (PELNs) as candidate immunomodulatory and mucosal-repair platforms. The evidence is dominated by chemically induced rodent colitis, particularly acute mucosal injury models; controlled efficacy data in patients with luminal ulcerative colitis or Crohn's disease are not available, and the small uncontrolled perianal-fistula study provides only preliminary local safety and feasibility observations. Reported outcomes include changes in inflammatory myeloid states, tolerance-associated dendritic-cell states, Treg/Th17 balance, epithelial protection, barrier restoration, tissue repair, and, for a narrower subset of preparations, stem/progenitor-associated regeneration. Mechanistic intervention studies include dendritic-cell AMPK dependence for broccoli-derived nanoparticles and PD-1/PHB1-related activity for engineered PD-L1/miR-27a-3p EVs, whereas many macrophage, microbiota, barrier, and cargo-delivery claims remain associative or preparation-specific. Engineering may improve exposure, target-cell engagement, cargo control, or receptor signaling, but each proposed advantage requires direct comparison with an appropriate unmodified or clinically relevant comparator and introduces additional manufacturing and safety requirements. We therefore separate product identity, disease-relevant regional or systemic exposure, target-cell engagement, functional intracellular cargo delivery, surface-receptor signaling, pharmacodynamic response, and repair outcomes. Translation will require reproducible dose metrics, mechanism-linked validation, validated lot-release potency assays, chronic repeat-dose safety, and phenotype-relevant human models.

papers.title: ILC plasticity in intestinal immune barrier remodeling: current evidence and therapeutic implications for inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Zhou Z, Ling P, Wang J, Zhang X, Shen Y
papers.abstract: Inflammatory bowel disease (IBD), which includes Crohn's disease (CD) and ulcerative colitis (UC), is a group of chronic gastrointestinal inflammatory diseases characterized by persistent mucosal inflammation and intestinal immune barrier dysfunction. Innate lymphoid cells (ILCs) are key regulators of mucosal immunity; however, the contribution of their context-dependent plasticity to IBD-associated immune barrier remodeling remains incompletely defined. This narrative review summarizes the intestinal distribution and functional specialization of ILC subsets, their dysregulation in the IBD microenvironment, and the molecular signals that regulate ILC plasticity. Current evidence most strongly supports an ILC3-to-ILC1 transition in CD, whereas direct evidence for defined directional ILC plasticity in UC and for ILC2 lineage conversion in intestinal IBD remains limited. We also discuss the context-dependent roles of ILC2s in epithelial repair, inflammation, and fibrosis, as well as the functional reprogramming of ILC3s from barrier-protective to potentially pathogenic states. In addition, this review summarizes the cytokine, transcriptional, epigenetic, and metabolic mechanisms associated with ILC fate remodeling and discusses potential therapeutic strategies targeting these pathways. Overall, ILC plasticity may represent a disease- and tissue-specific mechanism contributing to intestinal immune barrier remodeling, although its causal role and therapeutic relevance require further validation in human IBD. These findings provide a framework for developing more precisely stratified and context-dependent therapeutic approaches for IBD.

papers.title: Optimising clinical trial design choices in inflammatory bowel disease
papers.authors: Bossuyt P, Moscicka K, Stoyanova K, Zalud J, Shelton L
papers.abstract: The success of inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) clinical trials is strongly influenced by study design and disease-specific operational challenges. Over the past decade, however, IBD clinical trials face slow enrolment, poor retention, accumulating costs and limited representativeness. Trials are further constrained by protocol and operational complexity, financial pressures and regulatory requirements. Carefully selected and optimised trial designs may address the inherent challenges of IBD research and should take into account the patient profiles under investigation, mode of action and speed of onset of effect of the investigational product, among other factors. This narrative review discusses four key study design strategies for IBD clinical trials, including treat-through maintenance, responder re-randomisation, Master Protocol approaches (basket, umbrella and platform trials) and Bayesian methodologies. Treat-through maintenance designs are effective at evaluating sustained efficacy and real-world durability, whereas responder re-randomisation approaches are widely used in drug registration programmes to distinguish induction and maintenance effects for regulator clarity. Master Protocol designs may improve efficiency and reduce placebo exposure, while trials using Bayesian methodologies can strengthen interpretation of efficacy and safety outcomes, particularly in early-phase or complex studies. Key considerations within protocols include the use of co-primary endpoints, selection of secondary/exploratory endpoints, control group design and integrating digital health technologies, among others. Strategic application of innovative methodologies can improve trial delivery and enhance data robustness and interpretability, thus supporting more efficient development of effective therapies for patients with IBD.
papers.title_zh: 優化發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）臨床試驗設計選擇
papers.abstract_zh: 發炎性腸道疾病（IBD）臨床試驗的成功與否，深受研究設計及疾病特有的操作挑戰所影響。然而過去十年，IBD臨床試驗面臨招募緩慢、留存率低、成本累積及代表性不足等問題。試驗further受限於方案與操作複雜度、財務壓力及法規要求。經審慎選擇並優化的試驗設計，可能可以解決IBD研究的固有挑戰，並應納入考量受試病人族群特徵、試驗藥物的作用機轉與起效速度等因素。本篇敘事性回顧討論了IBD臨床試驗的四項關鍵研究設計策略，包括：治療貫穿式維持設計（treat-through maintenance）、反應者再隨機化（responder re-randomisation）、主方案（Master Protocol）方法（籃式、傘式與平台試驗），以及貝氏方法學。治療貫穿式維持設計對評估持續療效與真實世界持久性有效；而反應者再隨機化方法則廣泛用於藥物核准計畫，以區分誘導期與維持期效果，供法規機構釐清。主方案設計可能提升效率並減少安慰劑暴露；採用貝氏方法學的試驗則可強化療效與安全性結果的詮釋，尤其適用於早期或複雜試驗。方案內的重要考量包括共同主要終點的使用、次要／探索性終點的選擇、對照組設計，以及整合數位健康科技等。策略性應用創新方法學可改善試驗執行、強化數據穩健性與可詮釋性，有助於更有效率地開發IBD患者的有效療法。

papers.title: Emerging roles of SLC6A14 in digestive system diseases: from amino acid transport to therapeutic targeting
papers.authors: Xia Q, Sun J, Yu Q, Li J, Zhou B, Zhu L
papers.abstract: The solute carrier (SLC) family comprises a large group of membrane transport proteins responsible for the transmembrane transport of nutrients, ions, metabolites, and drugs. SLC6A14 (solute carrier family 6 member 14) is a Na+ and Cl--dependent amino acid transporter with broad substrate specificity, capable of transporting a broad spectrum of neutral and cationic amino acids, thereby supporting cellular nutrient uptake and metabolic homeostasis. Altered expression, genetic variation, or dysregulated function of SLC6A14 has been implicated in inflammatory bowel disease, cystic fibrosis-associated gastrointestinal phenotypes, and several digestive system cancers, including gastric, colorectal, and pancreatic cancers. Dysregulation of SLC6A14 has been implicated in intestinal epithelial injury, regulation of intestinal fluid secretion, and tumor cell proliferation and metastasis. Together, these observations support a broad but context-dependent role for SLC6A14 in digestive system diseases. This review summarizes the transport properties of SLC6A14 and current knowledge of its functions in digestive system diseases, with a focus on its potential as a disease biomarker and therapeutic target.

papers.title: Biofilms in specific cancers: Helicobacter pylori, Fusobacterium nucleatum, Porphyromonas gingivalis, Escherichia coli, and Candida
papers.journal_full: Progress in molecular biology and translational science
papers.authors: Rajak S, Torabian P, Helmy Mohamed N, Asokan N, Abdelaziz R, Chaturvedi S
papers.abstract: An organized microbial communities encapsulated in a protective matrix are called biofilms, that have a major impact on how different types of cancer form and spread. The effect of biofilms produced by Helicobacter pylori, Fusobacterium nucleatum, Porphyromonas gingivalis, Escherichia coli, and Candida spp on the development and spread of cancer is examined in this study. Because they cause cellular damage, genetic mutations, and persistent inflammation, H. pylori biofilms are strongly linked to stomach cancer, such as F. nucleatum biofilms have been connected to colorectal cancer, where they stimulate the formation of tumors by modifying the immune system and activating pathways associated to cancer. A common periodontal infection, P. gingivalis, has been linked to pancreatic and oral malignancies by increasing tumor invasiveness and facilitating immune evasion. Some of the enterotoxigenic pathovars of E. coli can cause chronic inflammation and have genotoxic effects, often are related to colorectal cancer. Moreover, Candida species, specifically Candida albicans can form biological films in the gastrointestinal and oral tracts, helping in epithelial invasion and synthesizing carcinogenic byproducts resulting in esophageal and other malignancies. Examining the mechanisms of cancer emergence and progression by biofilms can provide insights on the influence of microbes on the development of cancer. Targeting the biofilm development can provide novel approaches for the treatment regimen of cancer.
